card.name: Final piece of drug generic names
card.fires_on: The last piece of a generic drug name that is split into parts, mostly the ending -pril (captopril, lisinopril, ramipril) and also -zole or -fen. It fires in drug label text where the drug is named as the subject of an instruction or interaction.

modes.label: -pril ending
modes.description: The final piece completing an ACE inhibitor name such as captopril, lisinopril or ramipril.
modes.example: daily dosage of captop<<ril>> should be reduced, and smaller increments utilized

modes.label: -zole or -fen ending
modes.description: The final piece completing a drug name such as dexlansoprazole, letrozole or flurbiprofen.
modes.example: Tamoxifen Coadministration of letroz<<ole>> and tamoxifen 20 mg

card.plain: It marks the end of a drug name that was split into pieces, especially ACE inhibitors ending in -pril.
